about: Geoffrey P. Anderson is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2011 - 2027. He works at Anderson Notarianni McMahon, LLC, located in Denver, Colorado, and provides legal services for issues involving Real Estate: Business and Business Litigation to the surrounding community.
Geoffrey Anderson completed legal studies at University of Denver Sturm College of Law and graduated with the class of 1985. Geoffrey Anderson passed the bar in 1985.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
